items.name: Stenay Que le Début 2026
items.information:
L’inscription est **gratuite** pour les **nouveaux compétiteurs** ainsi que les [**adhérents AFS**](https://www.speedcubingfrance.org/association/adhesion). Si ce n'est pas votre cas, l'inscription coûte 5€.
Merci de lire attentivement les **conditions d'inscription, la [FAQ](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/StenayQueLeDebut2026#67270-foire-aux-questions-frequently-asked-questions)  et les [tutoriels AFS](https://www.speedcubingfrance.org/speedcubing/tutos)**. 
Pensez également à consulter l'onglet **[Planning](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/StenayQueLeDebut2026#competition-schedule)**. 

----
Registration is **free** for **new competitors** as well as [**AFS members**](https://www.speedcubingfrance.org/association/adhesion), no matter your citizenship or place of residence. Otherwise registration costs 5€.
Please read the **registration conditions, the [FAQ](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/StenayQueLeDebut2026#67270-foire-aux-questions-frequently-asked-questions) and the [AFS tutorials](https://www.speedcubingfrance.org/speedcubing/tutos) carefully**.
Make sure to read the **[Schedule](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/StenayQueLeDebut2026#competition-schedule) tab**.

items.name: Ekerö Open 2026
items.information:
Välkomna till Ekerö Open 2026! Alla är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minuter samt oavsett tidigare tävlingserfarenhet. Vi ber er läsa igenom alla flikar på denna sida eftersom de innehåller mycket värdefull information.

--

Welcome to Ekerö Open 2026! Everyone is welcome to participate, regardless of whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes and regardless of prior competition experience. We ask you to read through all the tabs on this page as they contain very valuable information.

[![](https://cuboss.se/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/cuboss-svekub-loggor.png)](https://svekub.se/om_oss/svekub-cuboss/)

items.name: DeNxNver 2026
items.information:
Welcome back for a third rendition of DeNxNver! This is a winter competition put on by Colorado Cubers.

All competitors must read the Competitor Responsibilities tab before registering.
 
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcHB0IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--681018add857b2b9ddfd57914855080eeb87357a/Colorado%20Cubers%20Logo%20NT.png)

Even though on-the-spot registration is enabled, do not count on this! If the competition fills up, we won't be able to accept on-the-spot registrations, even if competitors do not show up. If you are able, we very much appreciate you registering in advance to save us time and effort, and save you some money!

items.name: Apex Algs 2026
items.information:

This competition is supported by [Southeast Cubing Inc](https://southeastcubing.org/about)
